jobs.title: Brand Identity & Logo Designer
jobs.summary: Create thoughtful brand identities, logos and visual systems for our brands and client projects. Strong freshers with quality portfolios and experienced designers are welcome to apply.
jobs.descriptionMd:
We are looking for Brand Identity & Logo Designers to work across Fixen Media, selected brands and client projects.

This role is focused on creating visual identities that are clear, distinctive and appropriate for the business they represent. Depending on the project, you may work on logo systems, typography, color direction, brand guidelines, visual language and supporting identity assets.

We welcome candidates from different experience levels. Strong freshers with thoughtful portfolio work are encouraged to apply, while more experienced designers may take greater ownership of brand strategy, identity systems and complex client-facing projects.

We are not looking only for someone who can make visually attractive logos. We value concept development, research, consistency and the ability to explain why a visual direction is appropriate for a brand.
jobs.responsibilitiesMd:
- Develop logo concepts and complete brand identity systems.
- Translate business positioning, audience and brand personality into visual direction.
- Explore concepts through research, sketches, references and visual experimentation.
- Create logo variations, lockups and responsive identity applications where required.
- Define typography, color palettes and supporting visual elements.
- Prepare brand guidelines and practical usage rules.
- Present design concepts clearly and explain the reasoning behind them.
- Refine concepts based on internal or client feedback without losing design consistency.
- Prepare professional production-ready logo and identity files.
- Maintain organized source files and asset libraries.
- Collaborate with creative, marketing and content teams when a brand identity needs to extend into campaigns or digital platforms.
- More experienced candidates may contribute to broader brand strategy and lead complex identity projects.
jobs.requirementsMd:
- Strong understanding of logo design and visual identity fundamentals.
- Good knowledge of typography, color, composition and visual hierarchy.
- Ability to develop original concepts rather than relying only on templates.
- Ability to translate a brand brief into a relevant visual direction.
- Working knowledge of professional vector-design software.
- Ability to prepare clean, scalable and production-ready logo files.
- Attention to detail, consistency and brand usability.
- Ability to explain design decisions and respond constructively to feedback.
- Understanding of basic brand-system thinking beyond a single logo.
- A portfolio, academic project or other demonstrable branding and identity work.

Formal professional experience is not mandatory for applicants with strong fundamentals and a thoughtful portfolio.
jobs.niceToHaveMd:
- Experience creating complete brand guidelines.
- Experience with naming, brand positioning or visual strategy.
- Experience designing for fashion, real estate, SaaS, technology or service businesses.
- Knowledge of grid systems and advanced typography.
- Experience preparing identity assets for print and digital use.
- Experience with packaging or merchandise applications.
- Motion-branding or animated-logo experience.
- Presentation and client-facing design experience.
- Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop or similar raster-design tools.
- Experience collaborating with marketing or social media design teams.
